title: Q4 Strategy: Customer‑led Private Deployment Playbook & Initiative Tagging
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Produce a concise, customer‑facing playbook and internal initiative tagging scheme that lets Sales/CS and Engineering coordinate lead-to-production Private/VPC/on‑prem deployments within an 8–12 week SLA. This ticket covers roadmap sequencing for Q4, OKR alignment, risk tranches, and the canonical rollout steps for new enterprise customers using Private (VPC) and On‑Prem packages.

Scope:
- Canonical onboarding path (Trial -> POC -> Dedicated capacity -> On‑prem pilot -> GA) with checkpoints and signoffs.
- Technical prerequisites: CNI/VPN patterns, KMS/HSM integration notes, RBAC baseline, audit-log retention SLAs.
- Upgrade/runbook: zero-downtime minor upgrades and documented rollback for major versions.
- Observability handoffs: console dashboards, per-deployment tracing hooks, cost breakdown exports for finance.
- Initiative tagging taxonomy: OKR/initiative labels, customer-priority flags, and risk tranches to appear in Linear and Confluence.

Key deliverables:
1) Customer Playbook (confluence link placeholder) with templated checklists and an estimated timeline for each phase.
2) Initiative Tagging Guide: mapping of PM/ENG labels to OKRs and release trains.
3) Deployment Runbook: step-by-step ops guide and automated verification scripts for smoke tests.
4) Risk & Escalation Matrix: SRE/Support/PM owners and SLA targets.
5) Rollout Schedule: default canary windows, monitoring thresholds, and fallback procedures.

OKR Mapping: 
- OKR-PD-1 (Reduce private deploy time to production): this playbook contributes to a target of 30% reduction in median lead time.
- OKR-Reliability-2 (0.1% downtime target for private): includes upgrade/runbook actions and observability checklist.

Acceptance criteria (see acceptance_criteria field): deliverables completed, tag taxonomy accepted by Growth/Sales/Eng, and a dry‑run with one pilot customer scheduled before 2025-12-20.

Risks & Tradeoffs:
- Tradeoff: Strict security defaults (e.g., enforced HSM) increase time-to-production for SMBs — mitigated via a light-touch 'starter' config.
- Risk: Dependencies on ENG-4210 (autoscaler for Dedicated) could block canary capacity; mitigation: reserve burst pool for pilots.
- Risk: Multi-region private networking patterns vary by customer; include a small set of validated network architectures instead of exhaustive coverage.

Cross-functional owners: PM (Aisha Patel), Eng lead (Jun Park), SRE (Hannah Schultz), Solutions Eng / CS (Marisol Vega).

Artifacts:
- Confluence: /private-deploy/playbook/draft (placeholder)
- GitHub PRs: infra/upgrade-runbook#134 (placeholder)
- Dashboard: console/private-onprem-sla (placeholder)

Next steps:
- 2025-11-05: review draft with Solutions Eng for customer templates.
- 2025-11-10: tabletop dry-run with SRE and Support.
- 2025-11-18: finalize tagging guide and circulate for executive review.
